summary: Tested VIP subscription flow with KwikPay payment integration (MOCKED). All 18 backend tests pass (100%). Subscription tiers with USD & local pricing (KES/NGN) work correctly. Frontend subscription page shows all tiers, pricing, Popular badge, and upgrade buttons.
